initial_accounting_visibility.reason: Exact -j query showed just-finished jobs33/34 while broad native sacct output itself still contained29 original completed rows; corrected driver waits at most8 seconds for broad visibility before asserting at least30. No product parser/count change.

constraints: Two fixture CPUs,2GiB container memory; task/none and proctrack/linuxproc; actual process membership uses bounded local scontrol listpids, no cgroup enforcement claim.
No physical GPU, live SSH network, multinode or production-site resource-policy qualification.
26.05 COL-2 warning branch augments an actual native JSON response with a warning; job submission/cancellation/output are real. This is not evidence that Slurm naturally emitted that warning.
No performance claims; qualification ran alongside regression activity.

Archives include every top-level recorded command and stdout/stderr plus image/daemon metadata; transient SQLite caches/private helper working directories are excluded. Owned allocation lifecycle/receipt states are preserved in manifests.
commands: Existing qualify_slurm.py harness copied with review-findings scenario + explicit snapshot revision only; commands and source maps retained inside each archive. No product harness source edits.

qualified_source_archive.scope: Exact immutable package/scripts/source-manifest used in five-version runs; corrected24.05 evidence driver supplied separately.

pre_fix_pid_proof_reproduction.issue: Actual task/none + proctrack/linuxproc Heavy had cgroup_proof=false and no default PID reader; exact worker failed unverified placement, then cleanly relinquished. Final built-in conditional bounded listpids fallback qualified on all5versions.
